name: Focus Desk
description: A calm focus timer and personal scratchpad beside your Devdevian conversations. No network access.

listing.full_description:
## A little room to focus

Keep a 25-minute focus timer and a personal scratchpad beside the forum. Start, pause or reset the timer; notes save automatically on this device.

Switch between Focus (25 minutes) and Break (5 minutes). No sound, notification spam, GitHub permissions or network requests.

### Privacy and storage

Notes and timer state use the SDK’s account/extension-scoped device storage. They are not synced between devices and are not a secret vault. Disabling this extension hides the panel; your saved note remains until browser storage is cleared or you clear it here.

The timer uses a wall-clock deadline, so background tab throttling does not slow it down. Close the panel from Devdevian’s extension controls.

Source: examples/extensions/focus-desk in the Devdevian repository.
